newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR NETHERLANDS V SAN MARINO WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR NETHERLANDS V SAN MARINO WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for the World Cup group seven qualifier between the Netherlands and San Marino on Saturday:

Netherlands -- 1-Edwin van der Sar; 2-Michael Reiziger, 4-Frank de Boer, 3-Jaap Stam, 5-Arthur Numan, 7-Aron Winter, 6-Wim Jonk, 10-Clarence Seedorf, 11-Phillip Cocu, 9-Patrick Kluivert, 8-Dennis Bergkamp

San Marino -- 1-Federico Gasperoni; 4-Luca Gobbi, 3-Damiano Vanucci, 2-Mauro Valentini, 6-Ivan Matteoni, 5-William Guerra, 7-Riccardo Muccioli, 8-Marco Mazza, 9-Paolo Montagna, 10-Fabio Francini, 11-Bryan Gasperoni.
